title: Pure R.B.
summary: R.B. monsters only, with generic staples; the page's Machina, Clockwork and Sky Striker engines are left out. The deck has no searchable Normal Summon, so the opening is R.B. Stage Landing (an R.B. monster from the Deck or Extra Deck) or two of the self-summoning extenders into R.B. VALCan Booster, which searches a Spell. R.B. Funk Dock searches any R.B. card and floats a monster from the Deck whenever an R.B. destroys itself. R.B. Shepherd's Crook sets R.B. Last Stand or R.B. Next Phase from the Deck. Every Main Deck R.B. monster has equal ATK and DEF, so the generic Helping Robo for Underwater Combat, the newest Machine Link, pops a monster, revives an R.B., and searches one when it is banished.
main: R.B. Ga10 Cutter
Summons itself; linked to an R.B. Link, pays LP to negate and destroy a Spell/Trap.
R.B. Ga10 Driller
Summons itself; linked to an R.B. Link, pays LP to destroy a monster on either turn.
R.B. VALCan Rocket
Summons itself; linked, destroys up to two cards and burns.
R.B. Lambda Blade
Summoned: sends an R.B. card to the GY; linked, steals a monster on their turn.
R.B. Lambda Cannon
Summoned: returns an R.B. monster from the GY to the hand.
R.B. Ga10 Pile Bunker
Summons itself; with The Brute Blues pointing at it, wipes their side in battle.
R.B. Stage Landing
One-card starter: summons an R.B. from the Deck or Extra Deck.
R.B. Funk Dock
Field Spell: searches an R.B. card and floats a monster from the Deck when an R.B. leaves.
R.B. Operation Test
Revives a Level 3+ R.B. and recycles them for LP and a fresh summon.
R.B. Next Phase
Counter Trap: destroys your own monster to negate a monster effect.
R.B. Last Stand
Summons an R.B. from the Deck, Extra Deck or GY; negates targeting from the GY.
